name: standing-desk
title: IDÅSEN Desk
description: Control an IKEA IDÅSEN standing desk over Bluetooth
author: cristian

commands.name: desk-menu
commands.title: Standing Desk Menu
commands.description: Control the desk from a menu bar icon and see its height in the menu

commands.name: manage-desk
commands.title: Manage Standing Desk
commands.description: View the height and control every desk action

commands.name: sit
commands.title: Move Desk to Sit
commands.description: Move the desk to the saved sitting position

commands.name: stand
commands.title: Move Desk to Stand
commands.description: Move the desk to the saved standing position

commands.name: raise
commands.title: Raise Desk
commands.description: Raise the desk by the configured step

commands.name: lower
commands.title: Lower Desk
commands.description: Lower the desk by the configured step

commands.name: save-sit
commands.title: Save Current Height as Sit
commands.description: Replace the sitting position with the current desk height

commands.name: save-stand
commands.title: Save Current Height as Stand
commands.description: Replace the standing position with the current desk height

scripts.test: vitest run && npm run build:native && ./assets/deskctl self-test
